verdict.summary: The added self-test exercises the previously uncovered production write seam end to end while keeping reads faked at the correct boundary. It restores both subprocess.run and GH_DEBUG on all paths, verifies exact executed argv shapes, the SHA-bound relatch mutation, absence of arm/admin/label hazards, minted-token propagation with debug scrubbing, non-zero process return-code propagation, and stdout normalization. The anti-vacuity checks ensure the write-path assertions cannot pass merely because no writes occurred, and the existing flow tests separately pin failure sequencing. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident in the diff.
